newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India drifts, Korea slips in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India drifts, Korea slips in quiet trade.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts finished a quiet session a tad lower on Wednesday amid concern about local market prospects, traders said.
The market appears hesitant about pushing higher following steady recent gains, and would await local market direction, they said.
Traders said players were seen sticking to quality in the short term, and expected consolidation this week.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed 0.05 points off at 83.22, with the premium over the local market at 27.09 percent from 27.48 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index closed up 22.57 points at 3,861.42.
Korean GDRs finished easier following recent strong gains and after local stocks drifted lower earlier.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index lost 0.65 points to 76.40 points, a premium of 45.50 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index rose 1.25 points, or 1.04 percent, to 120.77, representing a discount to the local market of 2.68 percent.
